data.title: A Clean Run
data.text: The margin note calls this a clean run: nothing anyone built was broken. The iceberg crossed one waterfall, then entered the sea. The bolted stone and the Gate kept their places. Below the falls, the rowan was untouched; at Vell Foot, the survey hut still held its kettle on the shelf. The hut note in the archive is small and ordinary: someone went up to look for the stakes, could not find them, and left the tea. I leave that note beside the route. The river went through without taking the hut, the stones, or the tree. It is a beginning measured less by what fell than by what the water passed.
